title: Pregnancy Recipes: Iron-and-Folate Bowls You Can Cook in 30 Minutes
excerpt: Three tasty recipes pairing heme/non-heme iron with vitamin C — Vietnamese-inspired bowls with clear amounts and food-safety notes.
content:
## Introduction
During pregnancy, it's essential to consume enough iron and folate to ensure the health of both mother and baby. Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate supports the development of the fetus. However, choosing iron- and folate-rich foods can be a challenge. In this article, we'll introduce three simple and delicious recipes that combine iron with vitamin C, providing a nutritious and safe meal for pregnant women.

## Nutrient Analysis
Iron and folate are two crucial nutrients during pregnancy. Iron helps prevent anemia, while folate supports the development of the fetus's brain and spinal cord. Vitamin C also plays a vital role in enhancing iron absorption. Here are three recipes that combine iron with vitamin C:

* Recipe 1: Grilled Chicken Bowl with Mixed Greens and Orange
 + 100g grilled chicken (20g protein, 1.5mg iron)
 + 100g mixed greens (20mg vitamin C, 1mg iron)
 + 1 orange (100mg vitamin C)
* Recipe 2: Beef Stir-Fry Bowl with Bok Choy and Bell Peppers
 + 100g beef stir-fry (25g protein, 2mg iron)
 + 100g bok choy (20mg vitamin C, 1mg iron)
 + 1 bell pepper (100mg vitamin C)
* Recipe 3: Grilled Fish Bowl with Romaine Lettuce and Lemon
 + 100g grilled fish (20g protein, 1mg iron)
 + 100g romaine lettuce (10mg vitamin C, 0.5mg iron)
 + 1 lemon (50mg vitamin C)

## Food Safety Notes
When cooking for pregnant women, it's essential to consider food safety to avoid food poisoning. Here are some notes:

* Choose fresh and clean ingredients
* Cook food thoroughly before consumption
* Avoid eating raw or undercooked food, especially meat, eggs, and seafood
* Wash hands before cooking and after handling food

## Cooking Tips
Here are some cooking tips to help pregnant women enjoy a nutritious and delicious meal:

* Use olive or coconut oil for cooking
* Add herbs and spices to enhance flavor
* Eat slowly and chew thoroughly to improve nutrient absorption
* Drink plenty of water to stay hydrated

## Conclusion
The three recipes above combine iron with vitamin C, providing a nutritious and safe meal for pregnant women. Remember to consider food safety and use olive or coconut oil for cooking. Additionally, pregnant women should drink plenty of water and eat slowly to improve nutrient absorption. For more information on prenatal nutrition, visit our [website](/planner).

faqs.question: How can I increase iron absorption?
